title: Stay Signed In
lede: People were signed out after 12 hours, or after 30 days when they ticked the box, however much they used the app. Now a session extends while it is used, and keeping people signed in is the default.

sections.heading: Side by side
sections.note: Baseline is main at c7c9fff5 in a clean worktree. Both sides use the same Playwright Chromium viewport and the same mocked discover, passkey and login responses.

pairs.title: Email step
pairs.afterCap: "Keep me signed in" starts ticked, and it applies to a passkey sign-in from this step too.

pairs.title: Password step
pairs.beforeCap: "Remember me for 30 days" starts unticked, so most sign-ins ended after 12 hours.
pairs.afterCap: Starts ticked. With it ticked, the session lasts while it is used at least once every 30 days, up to 90 days.

sections.heading: Account creation (after only)
sections.note: Not shown as a pair because the new checkbox makes the two images different heights. Baseline image: before-onboarding.png, with receipt before-onboarding-evidence.json.

changes.h: Sessions ended on a fixed clock
changes.was: Expiry was set at sign-in and never moved. That meant 12 hours by default, 30 days when remembered, and 30 days for everyone on iPhone.
changes.now: Each use pushes expiry back out (D-066). Remembered sessions get 30 idle days with a 90-day cap. Unremembered ones get 12 idle hours, a 7-day cap, and end when the browser closes.

changes.h: Remember me was opt-in and missing on account creation
changes.was: The box started unticked and was hidden while creating an account, so every new account began with a 12-hour session.
changes.now: "Keep me signed in" starts ticked and shows on every step. Account creation honors it, and native sign-up defaults to remembered.

changes.h: Signing back in lost your place
changes.was: A signed-out deep link went to /login and then to the home page.
changes.now: The page you asked for is carried as a validated same-origin returnTo. In the after run, a mocked password sign-in from /login?returnTo=/items?q=lens navigated to /items?q=lens. The before run went to /.

changes.was: There was no passkey endpoints document.
changes.now: /.well-known/passkey-endpoints sends 1Password, Chrome and Apple Passwords to Settings → Security, where passkeys are created and managed.

verification: Before run: box unticked, no box during account creation, login sent rememberMe false, landed on /.
After run: box ticked, box present during account creation, login sent rememberMe true, landed on /items?q=lens.
vitest: all 750 files pass (5,605 tests), including the new sliding-session and returnTo tests.
npx tsc --noEmit, eslint on the changed files, npm run build:app, npm run verify:docs, and db:migrate:check all pass.
notes: Captures use mocked API responses. They show the screens and what the client sends, not real sessions.
